source: BUILD_PLAN §10. Store: ops.feature_flags; read through api.flags() (schemas/flags.schema.json). Adding a flag means an entry here and a migration row.
notes: default is the value T04 seeds (api.flags, PR #4). The task that ships a feature flips its flag in its own migration.
audience: anon flags reach everyone, user flags only signed-in buyers, internal flags never leave the server.
Build-time modes (PLINTH_DATA, AI_MODE, META_MODE, PLINTH_FETCH_MODE) and data states (facts-only for a group, claimed, stale, re-scoring) are not flags.

flags.description: Show bands, natural frequencies and reasons. Off = stage S1 (the launch default T04 seeds): band fields are null server-side, truth-panel facts only. The fixture world's expected outputs show bands (display.bands_public true).
Live HARERA fetching. Needs this flag and HARERA_LIVE_FETCH_APPROVED=yes (after the legal memo).
Kill switch for Ask Plinth (the ask edge function). Off: the templated fallback only.
Kill switch for document checks (claims, cost sheet, pay-as-built, before you pay).
Kill switch for Visualise (stage-room). Every image carries "AI-generated illustration".
Kill switch for WhatsApp sends from outbox-dispatch (mock in local, CI and dev).
Kill switch for routing inbound WhatsApp messages (the webhook still acknowledges and stores them).
Kill switch for FCM push sends.
The replay slider on Following. R1 ships jump chips; the slider is optional.
Family circle: invites, JOIN <code>, shared shortlist notes.
The developer workspace (/workspace) and its RPCs.
Site-visit booking, the visit pass and the co-pilot questions.
Agents: agent check, profiles, agent of record. No broker money flows in R1.
Pro checkout (₹999 per project · 12 months of written updates). Off until a payment partner exists; alerts are always free.
MapLibre + PMTiles maps. Off: list views only.
Emergency switch: every page shows "Band withheld · facts only".
